shots.name: Green Tea Shot
shots.taste: Peach, citrus and a gentle whiskey finish.
shots.note: Despite the name, this version contains no brewed tea. Some venues add a little lemon-lime soda.
steps: Chill a shooter glass large enough for the measured pour and a little ice dilution.
Add the measured ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake until chilled, about 10–15 seconds.
Strain into the chilled glass. Serve without a garnish.

shots.name: B-52
shots.taste: Coffee, cream and orange in three distinct layers.
shots.note: Layer in the listed order. Ingredient density varies by brand, so pour each layer slowly.
steps: Chill a shooter glass.
Pour coffee liqueur into the glass.
Hold a barspoon just above the first layer. Slowly pour irish cream liqueur over the back of the spoon.
Repeat slowly with orange cognac liqueur (grand marnier) for the top layer. Serve chilled.

shots.name: Baby Guinness
shots.taste: Coffee liqueur topped with a creamy pale layer.
shots.note: There is no beer in this shot. The cream cap makes it resemble a tiny stout.
steps: Chill a shooter glass.
Pour coffee liqueur into the glass.
Hold a barspoon just above the first layer. Slowly pour irish cream liqueur over the back of the spoon.
Leave the layers undisturbed and serve chilled.

shots.name: Buttery Nipple

steps: Chill a shooter glass.

Hold a barspoon just above the first layer. Slowly pour irish cream liqueur over the back of the spoon.
Leave the layers undisturbed and serve chilled.
